newsitem.title: JORDAN: Arab Bank manages syndicated $18 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Arab Bank manages syndicated $18 mln loan.

text.p: Jordan's Arab Bank is lead managing with a group of banks a syndicated dual currency loan to Jordan's Mobile Telephone Service Company worth a total of $18.25 million, bank officials said on Wednesday.

The five year loan replaces an earlier $15 million bridge loan granted earlier this year. It is made up of tranches of 10 million dinars ($14 million) and $4.25 million. The bank did not say what interest it was charging.
It will help privately owned Jordan Mobile Telephone Service Company to finance the cost of extending its cellular phone network system by the end of 1998 at an total investment cost of $180 million.

The other banks and institutions involved in the loan are Housing Bank, Citibank, Union Bank for Savings and Investment, British Bank of the Middle East, the government pension fund, Jordan Investment and Finance Bank, Arab Banking Corporation/Jordan and Export and Finance Bank.
